_about: The Dispatch Counter's job board (VS-14; structure is the Level Designer's, the words are placeholders for the Writer). Same shape as world/jobs.json (JobBoard reads that shape). 'board' is the placement id of the job board node in market_dispatch (mk_dp_board). Main job 'Yard 9': taking it sets job_main_taken and hands over the Courier Pass; that flag opens Gate 4's boom barrier (door mk_gt_to_junk). It is done when the slice boss is beaten (flag kasp_beaten). Side 1 'Charge-up delivery' (battery brick to Grandma Ume's window: crate, crate, ledge; done flag job_charge_done) and side 2 'Appeal in triplicate' (Pell's form to the APPEALS slot at Gate 4; done flag job_appeal_done). Job ids are yard_9, charge_up and appeal_market (not main/appeal) so they never clash with Harrow's ids when the two jobs files are merged. Placements.job() and JobBoard read this file in slice mode (GameMode.job_ids).

yard_9.title: Main: Yard 9
description: MAIN JOB. The Signals scrapyard behind the ore line. Everything they confiscate ends up there. Bring back what is ours.
Show the pass at Gate 4. Do not make a noise on the road.

take.text: Job taken. Courier Pass in hand. Gate 4 is through the arch.

taken_text: Yard 9. Gate 4, show the pass. Why are you still reading?
done_text: Yard 9 cleared. Stamped DONE. The whole market is whispering about it.

charge_up.title: Side: Charge-up delivery
description: SIDE JOB. One battery brick to Grandma Ume's window above the Corner Shop. Two crates, then the ledge.
Pay: a Lucky Bolt and 100 credits. Do not touch the cords.

take.text: Battery brick handed over. Heavier than it looks.

taken_text: Battery brick to Ume's window. Hop the crates to the ledge.
done_text: Phones charged. Stamped DONE. Pay's on the sill.

appeal_market.title: Side: Appeal in triplicate
description: SIDE JOB. Collect a form from Pell on the Wharf. Drop it in the APPEALS slot at Gate 4.
Pay: 150 credits and a useful item.

take.text: Job taken. Pell is on the Wharf.

taken_text: Get the form from Pell on the Wharf. Drop it in Gate 4's APPEALS slot.
done_text: Appeal filed, in triplicate. Stamped DONE.
